newsitem.title: USA: Airbus drives for China orders - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Airbus drives for China orders - WSJ.

text.p: Airbus Industries Inc is making an aggressive push to expand aircraft sales in China, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition on Monday.
The European consortium was said to be pushing hard to win orders for as many as 70 smaller aircraft as well as 15 to 25 of its larger A-340 and A-330 models, the paper said.
Top Airbus executive Jean Pierson visited China last week. The China Daily Business Weekly said Airbus's priority there was a joint venture to produce 100-seat airliners.
On March 4, an industry source told Reuters Airbus put in a bid for China's requirement for 100 narrow-body passenger aircraft, estimated to be worth around $5 billion.
